event_types.description: Account creation observed at source signup date.
event_types.name: ACCOUNT_CREATED
event_types.prohibited_use: Do not enrich with account_name or snapshot churn_flag.

event_types.allowed_use: Episode construction and as-of journey ordering.
event_types.description: Subscription episode start observed in the subscription source.
event_types.name: SUBSCRIPTION_STARTED
event_types.prohibited_use: Do not infer upgrade, downgrade, or churn from snapshot flags.

event_types.allowed_use: Outcome chronology after the end timestamp.
event_types.description: Subscription end observed when a source end date exists.
event_types.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ENDED
event_types.prohibited_use: Do not use as a pre-outcome feature without an as-of cutoff.

event_types.description: Feature usage record preserved at source grain.
event_types.name: FEATURE_USED
event_types.prohibited_use: Do not use quarantined usage or collapse duplicate IDs silently.

event_types.allowed_use: Support interaction sequencing after account creation.
event_types.description: Support ticket submission observed in the source.
event_types.name: SUPPORT_TICKET_OPENED
event_types.prohibited_use: Do not attach response, satisfaction, or closure facts before available.

event_types.allowed_use: Post-closure journey analysis with an as-of cutoff.
event_types.description: Support ticket closure observed when a close timestamp exists.
event_types.name: SUPPORT_TICKET_CLOSED
event_types.prohibited_use: Do not expose closure attributes before closed_at.

event_types.description: Explicit non-reactivation churn occurrence at account grain.
event_types.name: CHURN_RECORDED
event_types.prohibited_use: Do not use reason, refund, feedback, or the event itself before outcome.

event_types.allowed_use: Return-cycle reconstruction after a prior churn.
event_types.description: Explicit source-marked reactivation retained as a distinct account event.
event_types.name: REACTIVATION_RECORDED
event_types.prohibited_use: Do not infer an unobserved subscription or erase prior churn.
